report.Title: Registration Password Error Notifying Issue
report.Summary: The password validation message for account creation does not appear until after the initial attempt to create an account, leading to user confusion.
Steps: 1. Open the 'Create account' page.
2. Enter a valid email address: dev@example.com.
3. Enter a password with less than 12 characters.
4. Click on the 'Create account' button.
5. Observe the error message: 'Password must contain at least 12 characters' appearing on the next frame.

matched_facts: Password must contain at least 12 characters

report.Title: Duplicate Payment Submission Bug
report.Summary: The application allows users to submit payment twice, resulting in duplicate processing notices on the Review Order page.
Steps: Navigate to the Review Order page.
Observe the displayed payment amount of $49.00 for the Team plan.
Click on the 'Place order' button to submit payment.
Observe the subsequent frame indicating that the payment has been submitted twice.
Notice the error message stating 'Payment submitted twice' and the repeated invoice processing for both invoices.

report.Title: Button Overlap Issue in Mobile Profile
report.Summary: The action buttons in the mobile profile interface overlap with the content, causing potential accessibility issues.
Steps: Open the mobile profile section.
Observe the layout of the 'Message' and 'Edit' buttons in the first frame.
Navigate to the second frame where the 'Delete' button is displayed.
Note that in the second frame, the 'Delete' button overlaps with the 'Message' button, obscuring part of the interface.

missing_facts: Action buttons overflow the mobile viewport

report.Title: Loading Screen Stuck
report.Summary: The loading indicator remains visible without progressing to the account details, leading to a user experience issue.
Steps: Navigate to the account overview page.
Observe the initial loading state with the indicator spinning.
Wait for 2 minutes and notice that the loading indicator persists.
Realize that the workspace details do not appear even after the extended loading time.

report.Title: Navigation to Billing Settings Results in 404 Error
report.Summary: Attempting to access the billing settings page results in a '404 Page Not Found' error. The user should be able to view billing settings without encountering an error page.
Steps: Open the Northstar dashboard.
Navigate to the Billing settings.
Click on 'Manage billing'.
Observe that the user is redirected to a page showing a '404 Page Not Found' error.

report.Title: Invalid Card Number Error Message Display
report.Summary: The application displays an error message indicating that the card number must be 16 digits when a card number with fewer digits is entered, but the card number field does not validate the input correctly until after clicking the Pay button.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the Checkout page.
2. Enter a card number '4242 4242 4242 4242' (the card number is correctly displayed).
3. Click the 'Pay $49.00' button.
4. Observe the application processes the payment without error due to correct formatting.
5. Modify the card number to '4242 4242 4242' (missing last digit) and observe the validation after the payment attempt. An error message appears stating 'Card number must contain 16 digits.'

report.Title: Insufficient Contrast in Key Text
report.Summary: The key warning text in the Developer Settings page does not have sufficient contrast against the dark background, making it hard to read.
Steps: Open the Developer Settings page.
Observe the API credentials section.
Notice the warning text under 'Production API key' regarding expiration.
The text indicating insufficient contrast with the dark background impedes readability.

report.Title: Header Badge Discrepancy After Resolving Incidents
report.Summary: The header badge incorrectly displays '12 open' incidents even after all incidents are resolved, indicating a status refresh issue.
Steps: Open the Incidents page to view the list of incidents.
Observe that 12 incidents require attention (first frame).
Resolve all incidents as indicated.
Refresh the page and notice that the badge still shows '12 open' incidents (second frame).

report.Title: Upload Process Stuck at 73%
report.Summary: During the upload of 'checkout-bug.webm', the process becomes unresponsive and shows no progress for 5 minutes while remaining at 73%.
Steps: Navigate to the upload recording interface.
Select and initiate the upload of 'checkout-bug.webm'.
Observe the upload progress, which starts at 32% and reaches 73%.
Confirm that the upload does not progress for 5 minutes and remains stuck at 73%.

report.Title: Clipped Email Display in Workspace Members
report.Summary: In the workspace members table, the email address of a member is clipped and cannot be fully read, affecting usability.
Steps: Open the workspace members table.
Observe that the email 'alexandra.longlast...' is partially displayed and clipped, with an error message stating 'Member email is clipped and cannot be read.'
